user.title: Welcome to SlotSentry
user.description:
SlotSentry gives you a single place to manage PIN codes across all your Z-Wave locks.

This wizard will discover your locks, configure code lengths, and optionally set up a keypad lockout trigger.

Secure Mode can be enabled later via Reconfigure.

locks.title: Select Z-Wave Locks
locks.description: Select all locks you want SlotSentry to manage. The number of available slots will be determined by the lock with the smallest capacity.{unavailable_notice}

code_length_mode.title: Code Length Configuration
code_length_mode.description:
{discovery_notice}

If your locks accept different PIN lengths (e.g., some use 4 digits and others use 6), enable two code lengths. Otherwise, keep this off for a single length.

code_length_single.title: Code Length
code_length_single.description: Set the PIN code length that all your locks will use.

code_length_dual.title: Code Lengths — Short & Long
code_length_dual.description: Set the short and long code lengths. Short must be less than long. Each lock receives the code that matches its supported length.

lockout.title: Keypad Lockout — Optional
lockout.description:
SlotSentry can disable lock keypads when a trigger entity reaches one or more target states (e.g., when your alarm is armed).

Select the trigger entity, then choose which state(s) activate the lockout. You can select multiple states or type custom values.

data.lockout_target_states: Target states (lockout active when entity matches any of these)

confirm.title: Review & Confirm

abort.no_zwave_locks: No Z-Wave lock entities found. Ensure Z-Wave JS is configured and locks are paired.

error.short_gte_long: Short code length must be less than long code length.
error.no_lockout_locks: At least one lock must participate in lockout.
